infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: MuscleX reads your step count so your daily steps and step goal are up to date.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: MuscleX uses your location to record the route, distance and pace of an activity.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: MuscleX keeps recording your route while the app is in the background, so a run does not stop when your screen locks.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: MuscleX uses the camera to scan another member's code so you can add them.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MuscleX lets you add progress photos from your library. They are private to you.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: MuscleX checks which of your contacts already use MuscleX. Your contacts are never uploaded — only a scrambled version is checked.
